verdicts.proof: Old: PayAction.payMin in payment_screen_problems.dart:92-107 sets _serverAmount and _forceMinCharge then calls _doPayment; PayProblem.belowMinimum payment_refusals.dart:100-110. The sheet is PaymentErrorSheet.show (widgets/payment_error_sheet.dart:21-71), which in v2 only swaps the body to PaymentErrorSheetV2 (v2/error_sheet_v2.dart:36-63) with the same title, message, primary button and callbacks. The page note: v2 passes forceMin: _forceMinCharge (payment_screen.dart:1533) into PayRoundingNoteV2 (pay_parts_v2.dart:162-186), the same cardCharge(due, forceMin) rule and texts as CardRoundingNote (card_rounding_note.dart:33-36); the dock price is charge=_cardFor(amount) (payment_screen.dart:1502).

Old payment_screen.dart:1609-1614 UpsellSection(showProducts: cardCharge(_bookingDue).kind==normal && reservationUpsellEnabledProvider); UpsellSection returns SizedBox.shrink when !showProducts (upsell_section.dart:32). v2 computes the identical expression (payment_screen.dart:1540-1541) and renders UpsellSection only when _isNew && moto!=null && upsellProducts (payment_view_v2.dart:152-155), the same widget whose MgV2 branch is UpsellRowV2 (upsell_section.dart:34-44). Old was silent too.

_upsellBundled getter (payment_screen.dart:403-406) and _amount (:409-410) are screen logic shared by both looks; v2 receives bundledUpsell: _upsellBundled ? upsellItems : [] (:1529) for display only; order creation at :1365-1368 is look-independent.

Old upsell_section.dart:160-167 row tap does nothing when needsSize && !selected. v2 _UpsellCardV2._rowTap (upsell_row_v2.dart:95) is null in that case, and the add chip is not shown at all for an unselected size product (:130-148); only the size chips (:149-166) add it, with the same remove-then-toggle(size) sequence as old. Size label 'sizeLabel' shown in both.

Upsell order only after confirmed payment: payment_screen.dart:1363-1369 and the verifying path payment_screen_problems.dart:421 (upsell: _upsellBundled ? ...). Both are in the screen state, not in any view; PaymentViewV2 only calls onPay: _doPayment (:1543).

Old SavedCardPreview(card: defaultCard) when defaultCard!=null && !charge.noCharge (payment_screen.dart:1619-1620). v2 receives the same defaultCard (:1534) and shows PayMethodCardV2 when !charge.noCharge (payment_view_v2.dart:156-159), title '{brand} •••• {last4}', sub 'výchozí karta · expiry · holder' (pay_parts_v2.dart:91-102). When no card is saved v2 shows a generic card/wallet line instead of nothing, which does not weaken anything.
Old encryption note under !charge.noCharge (payment_screen.dart:1622-1629). v2 PayTrustV2(showStripe: !charge.noCharge) (payment_view_v2.dart:161; pay_parts_v2.dart:143-148). Old was small text too.

Old PaymentPayButton onPressed null when processing||expired, spinner + statusLabel, statusNote when processing (payment_header_widgets.dart:276-326). v2 PayDockV2 enabled: !expired, busy: processing (payment_view_v2.dart:171-182); rank dock MgCta taps only when active && !busy (mg_cta.dart:90, :212-217); SOS light dock MgBtnInk -> _MgButton enabled = onTap!=null && !busy (mg_buttons.dart:42; pay_dock_v2.dart:85-101). Verifying status and 'do not pay again' note shown under the CTA when busy (pay_dock_v2.dart:93-100, :133-140). Expired label 'timeExpired' replaces the label. _doPayment itself also returns early on _processing/_expired/_completed (payment_screen.dart:913).

Old label: isFree=charge.noCharge, freeLabel = charge.isWaive ? pdConfirmFree : default confirmOrderFree (payment_screen.dart:1639-1640, payment_header_widgets.dart:305-310). v2: freeLabel = charge.isWaive ? pdConfirmFree : confirmOrderFree, used when charge.noCharge, price null (payment_view_v2.dart:166-175). Same charge object and keys.
Old amount: charge.charge (payment_screen.dart:1638). v2 price: Money.czk(charge.charge) (payment_view_v2.dart:174), same charge = _cardFor(amount) (:1502, :1531).

CardPaymentSheet.show is the only card-sheet entry (callers payment_screen.dart:1149, shop_checkout_screen.dart:529) and the v2 face is chosen inside the same _CardSheetBodyState (card_payment_sheet.dart:316-333) with onPay: (_processing || !_cardComplete) ? null : _payWithCard, the same as old :421-423; _payWithCard re-checks at its start (:232 area 'if (_processing || !_cardComplete) return'). PayInkButtonV2 renders 45% opacity and no tap when onTap null (pay_ink_button_v2.dart:51-62). Google Pay button gets onPressed null while processing in both faces.

The PopScope(canPop: !_processing) and vertical-drag absorb wrap the sheet for both faces (card_payment_sheet.dart:467-475). v2 close ✕: MgV2Back onTap null while processing and dimmed to 40% (card_sheet_v2.dart:121-125; mg_back_v2.dart:92 passes null through, no default pop); its non-processing onClose is maybePop (card_payment_sheet.dart:323), which PopScope would block anyway. Status 'psSheetProcessing' shown as a pending banner (card_payment_sheet.dart:331-332; card_sheet_v2.dart:144-147).

_SubmitGuard and the result mapping (result==null && guard.submitting -> processing) live in CardPaymentSheet.show (card_payment_sheet.dart:60-89), shared by both looks; v2 only affects the sheet chrome parameters.
